description: StateRoot is the cross-harness continuity layer for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, Pi, DeepSeek Harness): shared persona, memory, plans, skills, sessions, and project history. Bootstrap-only: install the StateRoot CLI from official GitHub release assets and run once-per-machine `stateroot setup` so harnesses get hooks and the built-in session skill. Use when the user asks to install or set up StateRoot, when `stateroot` is missing from PATH, or when setup has not been run yet. Do not use after the CLI is installed and harnesses are interfaced — that built-in skill (`stateroot skill show stateroot`) is then the default. Not for resume, checkpoint, handoff, memory, or daily workflow.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
